summary: Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. filed an 8-K to report routine monthly distributions on its Class G, G-D, G-S, E, and I common stock paid on August 14, 2026. The distributions are $0.1900 per share gross, with servicing fees deducted for Class G-D and G-S. This is a standard operational disclosure, not a special situation. No strategic event, transaction, or structural change is indicated. The filing is routine and lacks any special-situation characteristics.
